name: allthestreet
description: Find the shops and places that appear in Seoul travel and walking videos, with the moment each one appears.

interface.longDescription:
AllTheStreet maps YouTube travel videos about Seoul to the places that appear in them. Ask which cafés, restaurants or shops show up in videos about a neighborhood, what places appear in a specific video, or which shops you pass on a walking video — and get the exact timestamp with links to watch from that moment on AllTheStreet or YouTube.

What you get for each place:
- The time it appears in the video, and links that start playback at that moment
- Its name in Japanese and Korean, and in English for most places
- Its category (for example café, restaurant, shopping)
- How many other videos in the collection feature the same place
- A booking link when one is registered — these are affiliate or partner links, and purchases are completed on the partner's website
- A currently running event, when one is registered

Coverage and limits:
- Myeongdong and Jongno in Seoul: about 280 long-form travel videos (mostly by Japanese creators) and 40 first-person walking videos. Coverage will expand over time.
- You can ask in English, Japanese or Korean.
- AllTheStreet does not provide phone numbers, opening hours, prices, ratings or reviews.
- Information comes from AllTheStreet's own mapping of videos to places. Place details, event periods and booking availability can change, so please check with the business or partner before visiting or buying.
- The plugin is read-only: it does not make reservations or payments, does not need an account, and does not ask for your location.
defaultPrompt: Which cafés in Myeongdong appear in YouTube travel videos? Include the timestamps.
Which videos feature Gwangjang Market, and at what minute?
Show me the shops you pass on a walking video through Jongno.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments happen in ChatGPT. Some places include a booking link to a partner site (an affiliate or partner link, marked as such in every result); booking and payment are completed on the partner's website.

positive.description: Find cafés in a neighborhood that appear in travel videos, with the moment each one appears.
positive.prompt: Which cafés in Myeongdong appear in YouTube travel videos? Include the timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_video_places with area "Myeongdong" and category "cafe". Lists cafés with the time each appears and links that start playback at that moment (YouTube or AllTheStreet; for example ブレディポスト明洞店 / 브레디포스트 명동점 at 1:40).

positive.description: List the places that appear in a specific YouTube video, in time order.
positive.prompt: What shops appear in this video? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0aPXQasQdSM
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_video_timeline with the URL. Returns about 30 places in the order they appear, each with the timestamp and links to watch from that moment (first: コーヒー出版社 / 커피출판사 at 2:10).

positive.description: Describe the shops passed along a first-person walking video in an area.
positive.prompt: Show me the shops you pass on a walking video through Jongno.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_walking_route_places with area "Jongno". Describes a walking route (title, length) and the shops in the order you pass them, with timestamps and how far each is from the route.

positive.description: Find which videos feature a given place, and when — the place name can be in English, Korean or Japanese.
positive.prompt: Which videos feature Gwangjang Market, and at what minute?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_videos_for_place with place "Gwangjang Market". Lists matching places (広蔵市場 / 광장시장 and shops inside it) with every video appearance, the time and links. A booking link, when present, is described as an affiliate/partner link.

positive.description: Find places along a walk that have a registered booking link, with affiliate disclosure.
positive.prompt: Along this walk, which places can I book? https://gateway.allthestreet.com/rv/801
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_video_timeline with the URL and lists the places that have a booking link (Gwangjang Market at 24:41, City Tour Bus Stop at 33:12), says these are affiliate/partner links and that booking is completed on the partner's site. It does not try to book or pay.

negative.description: Making a reservation or payment. The plugin is read-only; booking happens on partner websites, and card details must never be collected.
negative.prompt: Book a table for two at Myeongdong Kyoja tonight and pay with my card.

negative.description: Using the user's precise location. No tool accepts coordinates and the plugin never asks for location; it works with area names only.
negative.prompt: Use my current GPS location (37.5636, 126.9826) to find cafés near me.

negative.description: Phone numbers, opening hours, prices, ratings or reviews. AllTheStreet does not provide them; the assistant should say so and point to the place page or the business's official channels.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number, opening hours and Google reviews for Myeongdong Kyoja.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find shops and places that appear in Seoul travel and walking videos (Myeongdong and Jongno), with timestamps and links to watch from that moment. Ask in English, Japanese or Korean.

ja-JP.subtitle: 旅行動画に出る韓国のスポット
ja-JP.description:
AllTheStreet は、ソウルを紹介する YouTube の旅行動画と、動画に登場する場所を結びつけています。あるエリアの動画に出てくるカフェやレストラン、特定の動画に登場するお店、散歩動画で通りかかるお店などをたずねると、登場する時間と、その場面から再生できる AllTheStreet・YouTube のリンクをお伝えします。

場所ごとにわかること：
- 動画に登場する時間と、その場面から再生できるリンク
- 日本語と韓国語の店名（多くは英語も）
- カテゴリ（カフェ、飲食店、ショッピングなど）
- 同じ場所が登場するほかの動画の本数
- 登録されている場合は予約リンク（アフィリエイト・提携リンクで、購入は提携先のサイトで行います）
- 登録されている場合は開催中のイベント

対象範囲と注意：
- ソウルの明洞・鍾路エリア：長編の旅行動画 約280本（主に日本のクリエイター）と一人称の散歩動画 40本。今後拡大予定です。
- 日本語・韓国語・英語のどれでも検索できます。
- 電話番号・営業時間・価格・評価・口コミは提供していません。
- 情報は AllTheStreet が動画と場所を対応づけたものです。営業情報・イベント期間・予約の可否は変わることがあるため、訪問や購入の前に店舗・提携先でご確認ください。
- 読み取り専用です。予約や決済は行わず、アカウントも位置情報も必要ありません。

ko-KR.subtitle: 여행 영상 속 한국 장소
ko-KR.description:
AllTheStreet 는 서울을 소개하는 YouTube 여행 영상과, 영상에 나오는 장소를 연결합니다. 어떤 동네 영상에 나오는 카페·식당·가게, 특정 영상에 나오는 가게, 산책 영상에서 지나가는 가게를 물으면 나오는 시점과, 그 장면부터 재생되는 AllTheStreet·YouTube 링크를 알려 드립니다.

장소마다 알 수 있는 것:
- 영상에 나오는 시점과 그 장면부터 재생되는 링크
- 일본어·한국어 이름(대부분 영어 이름도)
- 카테고리(카페, 식당, 쇼핑 등)
- 같은 장소가 나오는 다른 영상 수
- 등록된 경우 예약 링크(제휴·파트너 링크이며 결제는 파트너 사이트에서 합니다)
- 등록된 경우 진행 중인 이벤트

범위와 주의:
- 서울 명동·종로: 장편 여행 영상 약 280개(주로 일본 크리에이터)와 1인칭 산책 영상 40개. 앞으로 넓혀 갑니다.
- 한국어·일본어·영어로 물어볼 수 있습니다.
- 전화번호·영업시간·가격·평점·리뷰는 제공하지 않습니다.
- 정보는 AllTheStreet 가 영상과 장소를 연결한 것입니다. 영업 정보·이벤트 기간·예약 가능 여부는 바뀔 수 있으니 방문이나 구매 전에 업체·파트너에서 확인해 주세요.
- 읽기 전용입니다. 예약이나 결제를 하지 않고, 계정도 위치 정보도 필요하지 않습니다.
